segments.text: Welcome to this synthetic test clip about running agents safely.
Everything said here was written for the test suite.
First we install the tools and configure a sandbox for the agent.
The sandbox has no outbound network access by default.
Next we run a small task and measure how long it takes.
The agent reads files, edits one of them, and reports back.
You should verify the result before you trust the report.
To create the project folder, run git clone on the example repository.
Then start the agent inside that folder.
A second agent can review the first agent's change.
Keep the two agents on separate files so they do not overwrite each other.
Write decisions down in a short work log.
After a long session, read the work log before continuing.
Now for the part that surprised us during testing.
The reasoning the agent printed did not always match the action it took.
So we check actions, not explanations.
That is why the sandbox blocks the network unless you enable it.
Test your own setup the same way before you deploy it.
Thanks for watching this synthetic clip.
